body.message:
thank you for confirming the rates: 6000 (July), 6500 (August), 7500 (September) — I appreciate that, but  However, I want to point out that the 50% advance payment for the last month’s rent was never part of our discussion when I proposed these rates. It appeared only after you had already confirmed the pricing. This is a new condition, introduced after the fact, and I did not agree to it.

I have always paid on time, every month, without delay, and you already hold my security deposit. I am ready to pay the July rent (6000 AED) today.

I kindly ask you to proceed with the confirmed rates as agreed, without adding this new 50% requirement. If there is a genuine business need for it, I’d be happy to discuss it closer to September — but it shouldn’t be forced into an agreement that was already confirmed.

Please confirm so I can complete the July payment today.
